lighting_notes: Bright, sterile, clinical — cool white light, high Exposure Compensation, minimal shadow softness (small Source Angle on key light) for a harsh medical-setting feel, deliberately uncomfortable rather than cinematic-warm.
action: Ananya lies on an operating table, looking terrified as the Doctor prepares the procedure.

dialogue.line: Are you certain about this, Mrs. Sharma?
Yes. Please... just get it over with.

continuity_notes: Short, tense beat. Doctor addresses her as 'Mrs. Sharma' — confirms she still carries the married name at this point, before the disownment in sc08.
